title: processing.failed.v1
description: Published by media-worker when audio processing or transcription failed after exhausting retries. Consumed by core-api, which moves the episode to FAILED.

stage.description: Pipeline stage where the failure happened.

errorCode.description: Stable machine-readable code, e.g. CORRUPT_AUDIO, UNSUPPORTED_CODEC, TRANSCRIPTION_API_ERROR, BLOB_NOT_FOUND.

errorMessage.description: Human-readable detail for logs and the review UI. Must not contain secrets.

retryable.description: Whether re-publishing episode.uploaded for this episode is likely to succeed.
